scripts.build: npm run frames && slidev build --base ./ --out dist
scripts.export:pdf: npm run frames && TMPDIR=/tmp slidev export slides.md --format pdf --output easy-is-taken.pdf --with-clicks --executable-path /usr/bin/google-chrome --timeout 60000
scripts.shoot: rm -f screenshots/*.png && node build/shoot.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8765 screenshots "1 2 3 4:0 4:1 5 6 7 8 9 10:0 10:1 10:2 10:3 11:0 11:1 11:2 11:3 12" --offline
